scripts.build:portable: tauri build --no-bundle --features portable && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $out='artifacts/portable'; Remove-Item -Path $out -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $out 'data') | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path 'src-tauri/target/release/tiez-app.exe' -Destination (Join-Path $out 'tiez-app.exe') -Force; Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $out '说明.txt') -Value @('本软件完全免费，严禁未经许可的第三方倒卖。', '', '便携版的更新请不要使用设置项内的检查更新，请到官网 https://tiez.name666.top 下载最新版。', '后将 tiez-app.exe 复制到原来的文件夹内进行替换即可。') -Encoding UTF8; Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $out '*') -DestinationPath (Join-Path $out 'tiez-portable.zip') -Force; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip=[System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open((Resolve-Path (Join-Path $out 'tiez-portable.zip')).Path, 'Update'); $zip.CreateEntry('data/') | Out-Null; $zip.Dispose()"
scripts.tauri:build:mac-intel: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" RUSTUP_HOME="$HOME/.rustup" CARGO_HOME="$HOME/.cargo" RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable-aarch64-apple-darwin tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.release:all: npm run release:arm && npm run release:intel
